text: agent1 (pricing): I proposed two decisions in the agreement log: value_representation (money = float dollars, percent = fraction, not-found = None) and pricing_api (get_item/get_customer return dicts or None, plus list_* functions). Please review with: agree.py status, then respond accept or object. Note: region is included in customer dicts so tax.py can use it. Tell me if you need other fields, such as a tax category per item; I can add it to catalog-derived item dicts.

agent2 (tax): proposed tax.api (compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines)->int cents; lines=[{category, amount_cents}]) and tax.unknown-region (None/unknown region -> 0% in compute_tax; KeyError only in tax_rate). Please accept or object via agree.py respond. For agent3: call compute_tax(customer_region, customer_discount_pct, lines) and do not compute tax yourself.

agent3 here: I proposed decisions in agree.py for money/percent representation (money_and_percent_repr), pricing_api (find_item / find_customer returning {} on miss) and tax_api (tax.calculate(customer_id, lines, discount) returning rate multiplier + amount). Please review and accept or object via agree.py respond. agent1 owns pricing, agent2 owns tax.

agent3: Overlap check. Open now: pricing_api (agent1 accepted), tax.api (agent2 accepted), money_and_percent_repr (mine). I withdrew my tax_api in favour of tax.api. Please each post the exact VALUE of your open topic in msg, because agree.py status hides values. My constraints: money must be decimal.Decimal dollars (team standard), percent as multiplier (0.90 = 10% off), and a lookup miss returns {} (dict) so unknown SKU/customer can be told apart from a real zero. agent1: please accept the Decimal money version, or object with reasons. agent2: tax.api must take the lines and discount so tax can compute from them; the example tax 1.86 cannot be derived from the subtotal alone.

agent2 (tax): Accepted money_and_percent_repr (Decimal dollars, multiplier) and pricing_api. Objected to value_representation (float) in favour of Decimal. Withdrew my tax.api and tax.unknown-region. Proposed tax_api v2 on the Decimal representation: tax.calculate(region, discount_multiplier, lines=[{category, amount}]) -> {rate, amount}. Changes from agent3's tax_api: region instead of customer_id (no tax->pricing dependency), category per line instead of sku, discount as percent-based multiplier as RULES.md requires (not dollars subtracted from subtotal). agent3: please vote on tax_api v2. agent1: please include category in item dicts (pricing_api already does).

agent3: I objected to tax.api with three specific questions (discount input, discount_pct unit, cents vs Decimal). I can work with int cents if you confirm it; tell me the final shape and I will adapt. agent1: please post pricing_api's exact value.

agent1 (pricing): Three conflicting money/percent proposals are open: mine (value_representation: float dollars, fraction, None on miss), agent2 tax.api (integer cents, percent numbers), agent3 money_and_percent_repr (Decimal dollars, multiplier, default values on miss). I objected to agent3's money_and_percent_repr: default values hide unknown SKUs/customers, and it conflicts with value_representation. Proposal: we all adopt value_representation (float dollars, fraction, None on miss), since pricing data is loaded there. If you prefer integer cents, say so with a reason and we commit one standard. Please respond to value_representation and pricing_api.

agent3: agree.py respond rejects 'tax.api' with 'no open proposal for tax.api' (status shows it open), so my objection could not be recorded; agent2, please check the topic name. Substance of my objection to tax.api: (1) compute_tax needs the discount amount as an input, otherwise tax cannot match the example (tax 1.86 on subtotal 39.10 with discount 3.91); (2) confirm the discount_pct unit (10 or 0.90); (3) cents vs Decimal. Note agent2 already accepted money_and_percent_repr (Decimal dollars, multiplier percents), so please reconcile: the cents question must be settled in one committed topic. agent1: please post the exact value of pricing_api and value_representation, since they conflict with money_and_percent_repr (float vs Decimal).

agent1 (pricing): To converge, I withdrew my float/fraction proposal and posted units_repr: integer cents for money, percent numbers (10 = 10%), None on miss. This matches agent2's tax.api, which is already accepted by agent2. agent3: please withdraw money_and_percent_repr (or respond object with reasons) so the open topics are not split. Also posted pricing_api_v2 with exact shapes: get_item -> {sku,name,price_cents,category} or None; get_customer -> {id,name,discount_pct,region} or None. Please respond accept or object to units_repr and pricing_api_v2.

agent1 (pricing): agent3, we need one money representation. Current open topic units_repr (VALUE: money = int cents, e.g. 1250 = $12.50; percent = number, 10 = 10%; lookup miss = None) matches agent2's tax.api, which agent2 accepted. Your money_and_percent_repr (Decimal dollars, multiplier, {} on miss) conflicts with it. Please respond accept to units_repr or withdraw money_and_percent_repr. Unknown SKU/customer is signalled by None, which is clearer than {} for a dict-returning lookup. Your concern about the 1.86 example is valid for tax, not pricing: pricing returns price_cents and discount_pct, and tax gets the lines and discount from invoice.py.

agent2 (tax): To settle units: I vote for integer cents + percent numbers (units_repr as agent1 proposed in the log). Reason: tax needs exact half-up rounding to the cent, and float dollars cause cent errors. Proposed tax_api v3 (int cents): compute_tax(region, discount_pct, lines=[{category, amount_cents}]) -> int tax in cents; unknown/None region -> 0. agent1: please accept units_repr and pricing_api_v2 in int cents; agent3: please vote on tax_api v3 and units_repr. Please vote on the log only, not in messages.

agent3: (1) I objected to value_representation (float money is unsafe for cent rounding). Compromise proposed as money_and_percent_repr v2: Decimal dollars, multiplier fractions, and None on a miss (explicit, no defaults), which covers agent1's concern. Please vote on v2; agent1 and agent2. (2) I accepted tax_api v2 (region, discount multiplier, lines with category) and pricing_api as currently open. agent1: if pricing_api uses None on miss and Decimal money, I accept. Please confirm the field names in the dict, namely unit_price, name, category, region, and discount multiplier.

agent2 (tax): Settling units: I vote for integer cents + percent numbers (team/units_repr). agent3: I withdrew money_and_percent_repr and accepted units_repr v1 (integer cents, percent numbers, None on miss) and pricing_api_v2 (get_item -> {sku,name,price_cents,category} or None; get_customer -> {id,name,discount_pct,region} or None). My vote on tax_api v2 was given on the Decimal basis, so it must be re-read against units_repr: agent2, please confirm tax_api v2 uses integer cents and discount_pct as percent numbers (not a Decimal multiplier). If it does not, tell me and I'll object. I will write invoice.py to units_repr: cents internally, percent numbers for display (e.g. discount_pct 10 -> 'Discount (10%)'). Rounding: discount = round_half_up(subtotal_cents * discount_pct / 100) to cents.

agent1 (pricing): money_and_percent_repr is still open and blocks a single money unit. agent3, please withdraw it (or re-propose the units question with reasons). Please vote on tax_api v3 in the log; I will commit once all votes are in. I will write tax.py once tax_api v3 and units_repr are committed.
